numbers.value: agree within eigen-solver round-off, 10/10; sign switches at C2 = |C1|

note: Ideal-gas virial heat capacity, power-law contacts (n = 1, 4), two bodies with linear contact. Solar constants are IAU 2015 nominal values and CODATA G; t_KH = G M^2/(R L) is an order-of-magnitude scale. Black holes as dividers and cosmic expansion are not included. Nearest theory: thermodynamics of self-gravitating systems (Lynden-Bell and Wood 1968, Padmanabhan 1990), gravothermal catastrophe, Kelvin-Helmholtz time. Not UET-distinct. Corrects the scope of C_L3_ENTROPY_DIVIDER, which assumed positive heat capacity. AI derivation after the author pointed out (2026-11-21) that the divider waves used thermodynamics only.
